project.name: ShardPilot core
project.description: Shared Java core used by the ShardPilot Gradle and Maven adapters for deterministic JVM test sharding. Balances class families using historical test durations or stable hashing when timings are unavailable, reads and writes YAML class manifests, and verifies complete, non-overlapping class selections with standalone JSON and HTML reports. Contains the common planning and reporting logic without Gradle or Maven APIs; test execution and process settings belong to the build-tool adapters and native runners. Includes secure JUnit XML timing import, complete-family history refresh and diagnostic JSON for candidate histories. Strict explicit selection validates chosen classes against complete eligibility and preserves eligible class families. Configuration profiles choose full, smoke or affected tests from committed Git changes, module dependencies and JSON/YAML contracts. Execution evidence checks native results and processes, while compiled-artifact manifests verify SHA-256 and source revision. Optional diagnostics report memory, timeouts, interruptions and leftover containers without deleting them.
